prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity decision comp for Dun, a personal reminder and timer app.
Primary request: Render a full-screen, screenshot-like app interface in a single portrait 480 by 800 logical viewport, approximately 960 by 1600 pixels. No device frame, no browser frame, no surrounding scene. This is the Timers screen in active use, emphasizing visual countdown mechanisms and persistent urgency.

Composition, from top to bottom:
1. Compact header, about 52 logical pixels high: the real product name "Dun" in bold dark ink at left, a small simple settings gear at right. Cool light app ground.
2. A compact three-part navigation strip: "Timers" is clearly selected, then "Reminders" and "History". Selected tab has a dark ink underline and strong type.
3. The expired "Eggs" timer owns the upper and largest section, roughly 300 logical pixels high. It is a flat alarm instrument panel with a decisive solid red header band reading "Time’s up" and a small bell symbol. Below, show "Eggs" as its name; a huge traditional circular countdown dial with simple tick marks, a substantial red perimeter, and gigantic tabular "0:00" in dark ink. Put "Finished 3:12 ago" clearly beneath the digits. The dial reads as a real clock-app timer, not an abstract chart. At its bottom, a wide primary dark-ink rectangular "Done" button with white text, followed by two equally clear outlined rectangular controls "Snooze" and "Restart". Done has the strongest action weight.
4. Two compact running timer instrument faces below the expired section, arranged as stacked horizontal rows, each around 108 logical pixels high, not tiny list entries. The first reads "Pomodoro" with very large tabular "17:24", a substantial visible circular countdown progress arc or clock dial at its left, then labeled controls "Pause" and "Reset". The second reads "Bread proof" with very large "38:00" and a clearly readable amber "Paused" label. It has a visibly paused circular dial, then labeled controls "Resume" and "Reset". The panel faces are flat white, precisely aligned, separated by thin cool gray rules.
5. A compact "New timer" area further down. A rectangular duration control reads "00h : 05m : 00s" with clear hour, minute, second grouping, and a strong rectangular "Start timer" button. One row of preset buttons below reads "Tea 4m", "Pomodoro 25m", and "Laundry 45m". All content fits in the frame and remains readable. Use no extra claims or prose.

Visual direction: Signal desk — dispatch and alarm instrument panels, with familiar clock-app timer mechanisms. An efficient personal utility, calm until something expires, then decisive. Use substantial rectangular controls with approximately 8 pixel corner radii. Clean one-family UI sans-serif typography; large crisp tabular time figures. Strong hierarchy, correct readable labels, real controls, generous enough spacing for a 480 pixel wide portrait screen. Flat instrument faces, thin clear borders. Restrained but professional high-fidelity finish, fully coherent as an actual app screenshot.
Color palette: exact cool light ground #F1F3F5, dark ink #17222C, decisive expired red #D84A34, warning amber #E7AE38, white panel faces. A quiet cool gray for borders and secondary text. No other saturated color.
Text verbatim: "Dun"; "Timers"; "Reminders"; "History"; "Time’s up"; "Eggs"; "0:00"; "Finished 3:12 ago"; "Done"; "Snooze"; "Restart"; "Pomodoro"; "17:24"; "Pause"; "Reset"; "Bread proof"; "38:00"; "Paused"; "Resume"; "New timer"; "00h : 05m : 00s"; "Start timer"; "Tea 4m"; "Pomodoro 25m"; "Laundry 45m".
Constraints: single complete portrait UI surface only. The expired Eggs dial and Done action dominate. Preserve the functional meanings of Done, Snooze, Restart, Pause, Resume, Reset, duration entry, start, presets, and navigation. No flashing, glow, gradients, decorative illustration, photographs, ornamental motifs, atmospheric effects, marketing text, fabricated metrics, delivery guarantees, people, device hardware, watermarks, or hand-drawn artifacts. Perfectly front-facing app screenshot, crisp high-fidelity control geometry and legible text.
